turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m a 30-year-old male, and for about a week I’ve had left-sided chest pain along with a productive cough that brings up purulent sputum and shortness of breath. I also felt feverish and very run down, and I was diagnosed with influenza recently but didn’t follow the treatment plan.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you experienced any changes in your vision, such as blurriness, blind spots, or any loss of sight?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—no blurriness, blind spots, or any loss of sight. My main issues have been the left-sided chest pain, purulent productive cough, shortness of breath, and feeling feverish and run down.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t smoke and I don’t have a history of smoking. I drink alcohol occasionally, but nothing else.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had nausea or any stomach upset—I mainly just have the left-sided chest pain, purulent productive cough, shortness of breath, and I’ve been feeling feverish and run down.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and nothing there has been painful—my symptoms are mainly the left-sided chest pain, the purulent productive cough, shortness of breath, and feeling feverish and run down.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling overall. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of psychological stress or emotional strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been under significant psychological stress or emotional strain. My main concern has been the left-sided chest pain, the purulent cough with shortness of breath, and feeling feverish and run down.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me better understand your current symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, specifically if it has appeared darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my urine color—no darkening or anything unusual. My symptoms are mainly the left-sided chest pain, purulent productive cough, shortness of breath, and feeling feverish and run down.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, have you noticed if the mass has been growing or changing in size rapidly?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or any changes in size of anything in my breast area—my symptoms are still mainly the left-sided chest pain, purulent productive cough, shortness of breath, and feeling feverish and run down.”
